scope: Full accumulated Phase 3B independent verification; no routing edits, production overwrite or later-phase work

statistics.route_length_definition: Longest separately introduced feed/branch measured from actual saved copper UUIDs; shared copper counted once. This is distinct from longest single segment and aggregate whole-net copper length.

via_in_pad_gate_scope: Phase 3B additions only, explicitly confirmed by user; unchanged baseline overlaps documented separately

source_to_required_endpoint_route_metric.method: Shortest source-to-required-endpoint paths on the final AFE_3V0 track centerline graph; same-net geometric contacts, pads and via transitions treated as zero-length connectors. Copper inside pads is not charged twice; vertical via barrel length and finite pad copper length are excluded. These are defined geometric path statistics, not resistance, delay or exhaustive longest-simple-path claims.

visual_review.source: Native KiCad plots exported from FinalClean without refill or save

readiness_limitation: Ready to promote the routing checkpoint after user acceptance; not a fully routed board, full-board DRC clearance or final manufacturing release.
baseline_via_in_pad_disposition: Unchanged frozen Phase 3A geometry. User explicitly scoped no-via-in-pad gate to Phase 3B additions. No blanket whole-board no-via-in-pad claim.
executed_commands: kicad-cli pcb export svg --layers F.Cu,B.Cu,In1.Cu,In2.Cu --common-layers Edge.Cuts --mode-multi --page-size-mode 2 --exclude-drawing-sheet -o phase3b_final_native_svg ARTHUR_EMG_RevA_Cost_Phase3B_FinalClean.kicad_pcb
